newsitem.title: JAPAN: Low-cost Japan construction shares fall in morning.
newsitem.headline: Low-cost Japan construction shares fall in morning.

text.p: Low-cost construction shares dominated the list of percentage losers on the Tokyo bourse on Tuesday morning as investors steered clear of the issues after recent failures in the sector, brokers said.
At midday, Daito Kogyo Co Ltd was down 39 yen, or 30.00 percent, at 91 yen, making it the biggest loser.
It was followed by Sata Construction Co Ltd, which was down 30 yen, or 11.54 percent, at 230 and Saeki Kensestsu Kogyo Co Ltd which lost 24 yen to stand at 189.
Brokers said that since the failure of Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd and Tada Corp, investors have been selling off shares of builders seen to be weak financially.
"In the past, if the firm still existed and the share price was below 100 yen, bargain hunters were lured to it, but not now," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
